paragraphs.text: The Westfield Tool Library lends tools such as drills, ladders and garden equipment to local residents. Membership costs £20 a year, and members can borrow up to three tools at a time.
Tools can be borrowed for a maximum of one week. Members who need a tool for longer can renew it once online, provided that no one else has reserved it.
Before you take a tool home, a volunteer will show you how to use it safely. Protective equipment such as goggles and gloves can be borrowed free of charge.
If a tool is damaged while you have it, report the damage when you return it. You will not be charged for normal wear, but members may be asked to pay for repairs if a tool has been misused.
The Tool Library is run entirely by volunteers and is open on Wednesday evenings and Saturday mornings. New volunteers are always welcome.

items.quote: members can borrow up to three tools at a time
items.prompt: Members can borrow a maximum of 1 ____ at once.

explanation.en: “can borrow up to three tools at a time” → three tools. £20 is the yearly fee, not a number of tools.
explanation.kk: «can borrow up to three tools at a time» → three tools. £20 — сан емес, жылдық жарна.
explanation.ru: «can borrow up to three tools at a time» → three tools. £20 — годовой взнос, а не количество.

items.quote: Tools can be borrowed for a maximum of one week
items.prompt: A tool can be kept for no longer than 2 ____.

explanation.en: The loan period: “Tools can be borrowed for a maximum of one week”. “No longer than” means “a maximum of”, so the answer is one week.
explanation.kk: Беру мерзімі: «Tools can be borrowed for a maximum of one week». «No longer than» — «a maximum of» дегені, сондықтан жауап one week.
explanation.ru: Срок выдачи: «Tools can be borrowed for a maximum of one week». «No longer than» значит «a maximum of», поэтому ответ one week.

items.quote: provided that no one else has reserved it
items.prompt: A tool can be renewed online if nobody else has 3 ____ it.

explanation.en: “provided that no one else has reserved it” → reserved. After “has” we need the past participle, as in the text.
explanation.kk: «provided that no one else has reserved it» → reserved. «Has» сөзінен кейін етістіктің үшінші түрі керек, мәтіндегідей.
explanation.ru: «provided that no one else has reserved it» → reserved. После «has» нужна третья форма глагола, как в тексте.

items.quote: a volunteer will show you how to use it safely
items.prompt: A 4 ____ explains how to use a tool safely.
keywords: show you how to use it safely

explanation.en: A volunteer teaches safe use: “a volunteer will show you how to use it safely”. The sentence needs the person who explains — volunteer.
explanation.kk: Қауіпсіздікті ерікті үйретеді: «a volunteer will show you how to use it safely». Сөйлемге түсіндіретін адам керек — volunteer.
explanation.ru: Правилам безопасности учит волонтёр: «a volunteer will show you how to use it safely». В предложении нужен тот, кто объясняет, — volunteer.

items.quote: members may be asked to pay for repairs if a tool has been misused
items.prompt: Members may have to pay for repairs if a tool has been 5 ____.

explanation.en: “pay for repairs if a tool has been misused” → misused. “Damaged” is wrong: normal wear is not charged.
explanation.kk: «pay for repairs if a tool has been misused» → misused. «Damaged» келмейді: қалыпты тозу үшін ақы алынбайды.
explanation.ru: «pay for repairs if a tool has been misused» → misused. «Damaged» не подходит: за обычный износ не платят.
